source.title: North Atlantic right whale, mixed sounds
source.author: NOAA Fisheries, Northeast Fisheries Science Center, Passive Acoustics Branch
source.prepare: ffmpeg -i <file> -ar 48000 -c:a pcm_f32le src48.wav; python scripts/sound-clean.py src48.wav right_moan_clean.wav --highpass 70 --lowpass 500 --denoise -12 --noise-pct 70 --over 2, then --source right_moan_clean.wav
source.notes: 8 kHz mono MP3, 27 s: a moan (2.7-5.6 s, 11 dB over the background), faint grunts, and two 'gunshot' cracks near the end, left out. Converted to 48 kHz first, then low-passed at 500 Hz (the background was mostly above it: 8 dB under the moan became 23) and denoised (34 dB).

clips.notes: the moan, with a grunt after it
